text:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync request — coordinating SI integration windows + co-marketing for H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Can we align certification deadlines, joint-demo slots, and marketplace onboarding so SIs have a clear 8-week runway?

sam (platform): +1. Main constraints: firmware rollouts for H200 and B200, and one required kernel patch on our inference nodes. Need dates by EOW to lock capacity.

jiwon (eng-runtime): Heads up — our runtime needs the new attention kernel for Gaudi quant paths. If we get the vendor validation image tag early we can run perf + stability in 2 weeks. Also need representative prompt sets from SI for regressions.

alex (solutions): From SI side — they need marketplace SKU mapping and joint-demo playbook by start of integration. Proposed milestone:
```
- Week 0: vendor validation image + firmware id
- Week 1-2: runtime perf + SI smoke tests
- Week 3-5: SI integration, security scan, marketplace listing prep
- Week 6-8: joint demo dry runs + final announcement prep
```
Is that realistic? :thinking_face:

vendor-nvidia: We can target dropping H200 validation images on Tue (image tag: nv-image-h200-v2). Firmware patch id fw-2026-03-15. We still have one microcode tweak pending, ETA this week. Recommend integrating our image into the Week 0 slot.

vendor-micron: MI300 timeline OK from our side. Validation image: mi300-rt-2026-03. Expect marketplace SKU docs out by next Wed. Link to draft spec: https://short.link/mi300-spec (internal).

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "HW vendor onboarding sync" Tue 15:00 PT — attendees: maya, sam, jiwon, alex, vendor-nvidia, vendor-micron. Event id: cal_98321\. :calendar:

maya (partnerships): Great — summary/next steps: 1) vendors drop validation images to S3 (nv-image-h200-v2, mi300-rt-2026-03) by Tue EOD; 2) jiwon to run perf/stability tests and post results to the shared doc; 3) alex to circulate SI prompt sets and marketplace SKU mapping template; 4) sam to confirm capacity reservation for canary hosts. I'll follow up with a short checklist. @jiwon @alex @sam :white_check_mark:

jiwon (eng-runtime): I'll spin up test fleet once images land. Will post perf numbers and any kernel blockers in thread.

alex (solutions): Will send SI playbook + SKU template by EOD tomorrow. Also coordinating demo accounts for regional customers (EMEA + US).

vendor-nvidia: I'll share the microcode note once QA passes. Ping me if you need binary diffs.

vendor-micron: Sending SKU doc to alex now.

maya (partnerships): Thanks all — if nothing major pops up we'll aim for integrated canary the week after next and a joint dry-run in Week 6. Closing the thread for day; will reopen if timeline shifts. :rocket:
